At the other extreme, Greenland is the lowest with its value at zero. The Netherlands has 534. This is one of the highest values in Europe. India and China, the giants, aren't the most crowded. has 488, China just 150. The emptiest big countries, Mongolia has 2, Australia has 4, Canada has 5, and Russia has 9.
